newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers dip, but Mediterranean edges up.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers dip, but Mediterranean edges up.

text.p: Rotterdam bunkers dipped by $1 a tonne in response to modest barge market weakness, while strong fuel oil cargoes in the Mediterranean supported bunker prices in southern Europe, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers were still talked in the range $86/$87 fob, as barges dipped to around $85 ex wharf.
The ARA market saw in excess of 15,000 tonnes of bunker demand, although the vast bulk of it came from only three companies.
"Those three are really only looking at very limited suppliers," said one independent player.
Hamburg bunkers were about $2 a tonne lower at around $91 delivered. The fall came partly in response to Rotterdam weakness and partly because of fierce competition for the small number of enquiries.
"There are hardly any vessels here, so the market seems to be dipping day by day," one supplier said.
Mediterranean prices meanwhile rose by an average $1 a tonne. Most ports were quiet.
